subject.title: fix(deps): keep fixture locks above security floors

question: Should Crabpot accept the new published Yuanbao fixture baseline and the scoped fail-closed npm-audit policy for fixture-changing pull requests?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and tested, but accepting a downgraded fixture package reference and an online security gate for fixture changes is an intentional compatibility and CI-policy choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the scoped security policy
options.body: Keep the relevant-change audit plus daily scheduled audit, confirm `2.17.0` is the intended Yuanbao published baseline, and merge after the final required checks succeed.

options.title: Keep audits scheduled only
options.body: Remove the pull-request audit prerequisite if maintainers prefer fixture changes not to depend on registry availability, while retaining the daily security workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped security policy
recommendation.body: Keep the relevant-change audit plus daily scheduled audit, confirm `2.17.0` is the intended Yuanbao published baseline, and merge after the final required checks succeed.
